extracted.intended_audience: media, stakeholders, the general public, and European Parliament staff (communication professionals)
extracted.subtask_description: Defines the Directorate-General for Communication's core objectives and operational tasks for communicating the European Parliament's work to media, stakeholders and citizens, including central and local outreach, campaigns, visitor services and support to Members and political groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communicate the political nature and Members' work
rubrics_metrics.description: The Directorate-General for Communication communicates the political nature of the institution and the work carried out by its Members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasise the political aspects of the Parliament and the activities of Members when framing messages and materials; ensure communications reflect institutional roles and democratic functions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Raise awareness of the European Parliament, its powers, decisions and activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Core business is to raise awareness of the European Parliament, its powers, its decisions, and activities among media, stakeholders and the general public.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target messaging to increase public understanding of what the Parliament does and why decisions matter; measure success by visibility and public knowledge among target groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inform, explain and enhance visibility through media collaboration
rubrics_metrics.description: Collaborate with the media to inform, explain and enhance the visibility of the European Parliament's work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work proactively with journalists and media organisations to provide clear explanations, background and access; prioritise clarity and newsworthiness to secure coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use bespoke communication and online campaigns to increase awareness
rubrics_metrics.description: Increase awareness among citizens, stakeholders and opinion leaders through bespoke communication and information campaigns and online channels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design tailored campaigns for specific audiences and goals; leverage online channels and campaign-specific formats; adapt tone, content and delivery to stakeholder/opinion-leader segments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bring institutional work closer to citizens via centralised and decentralised outreach
rubrics_metrics.description: Bring the work of the Institution closer to citizens on both centralised and decentralised levels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine pan-European (centralised) messaging with localised (decentralised) activities to reach diverse audiences; coordinate across central services and local offices for cohesive presence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foster sustainable links with citizens through enhanced visitor facilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Foster sustainable links with citizens through enhanced visitors facilities in Brussels, Strasbourg and in the Member States.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Develop and maintain visitor programmes and facilities that build ongoing engagement and understanding; use visits as a tool for transparency and direct citizen contact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide expertise and services to Members and political groups (monitoring, training, events, offices)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide expertise and services to Members and political groups such as media and public opinion monitoring, trainings, conferences for visitors' groups, offices in the Member States, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer monitoring, analytical, training and event services to support Members' communication needs; maintain local offices and resources to assist constituency-facing activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Go-local outreach via European Parliament Liaison Offices (EPLOs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Go-local and reach out to people through the European Parliament Liaison Offices (EPLOs) in the 27 EU Member States, in London and in Washington.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use EPLOs to implement local engagement strategies, adapt messages to national contexts, and maintain presence outside central institutions; coordinate EPLO activities with central DG COMM campaigns.
